page.layout: One page of text, single column; running head at top; catchword "Illis" at lower right; no marginal notes.

main_text.p: diem ubi corpus recepturæ & angelis æquandæ sint, permanere: alii deinde putabant ex sanctis alios tardius resurrecturos. Hinc preces pro maturanda resurrectione & animarum cum corpore coniunctione. Imprimis autem respiciebant ad tremendam illam iudicii diem, quam omnibus demortuis felicë ac beatam apprecabantur. Unde adhuc illud à multis memorationi piè defunctorum additum, Gott wölle jhm ein fröliche aufferstendnuß verleyhen.

Toto ergò cœlo differt praxis hodiernæ ecclesiæ Romanæ à veteris ecclesiæ consuetudine. Nam veteres precabantur pro sanctis omnibus, Pontificii pro peccatoribus quibusdam tantùm. Illi pro sanctis in æterna felicitate existentibus: hi pro miseris peccatoribus inter purgatorii tormenta versantibus. Illis nulla mentio purgatorii, eo tempore incogniti: his crebrò. Illis preces erant vota, his merita.

page.notes: The line "Gott wölle jhm ein fröliche aufferstendnuß verleyhen." is in black letter, rendered here as bl. Some words in the first lines are faint; "Parae" in the running head is read from the abbreviation "Paral." as printed. Marginal mark "•" beside "adhuc" is a printer's mark, not transcribed.
